parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is one half of the scissors consisting of a blade and a handle, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides one cutting edge and one handle loop for gripping. It works together with the other blade handle set to perform cutting actions.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the screw pivot relative to the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the other half of the scissors consisting of a blade and a handle, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the second cutting edge and handle loop, allowing the user to apply force for cutting materials.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the screw pivot relative to the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: This is the central screw that connects the two blade handle sets, made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the pivot point, allowing the two blades to rotate relative to each other for cutting action.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place while allowing rotational movement of the two blade handle sets around it.
